17791 DevOps Engineer II (Open)

Position Type:

Full time

Location(s):

IN.Bangalore.Office1

Position Details:

Overview
This job is responsible/accountable for streamlining offerings to CSGs end customers.
They take solutions from development and ensure they are operationally sound prior to rolling into production.
Products are evaluated and prepared for installation, configuration, monitoring, diagnostics, and process / procedure to ensure minimal impact as they are released.
Production optimization from a personnel perspective is a critical point and leveraging technology to ensure solutions adhere to customers SLA requirements for availability.
Job Description:
The incumbent is responsible for providing key support for their focused product / solution area to internal and external resources.
Support and maintenance of the customers production and non-production environments - including on-call support / work variety of shifts to include weekends, holidays or extra shifts/extended shifts or as needed.
Work with L1/L2/L3/L4 support and operations teams to ensure successful deployment and operation of their application and ongoing operational activities
Independently building and testing reliable and well-tested solutions and once released troubleshoot any issues, actively seeking out problems and solving them.
Support the build and deployment infrastructure used by our delivery teams
Respond to high severity production issues escalated by our operations teams along with root cause analysis
Test driven development, Agile development, continuous integration, continuous deployment, DevOps automation
Create seamless/automated build scripts used for release management across all environments.
Contribute to the DevOps community by way of good & best practices and support mentoring/coaching and training the wider team
Comprehend customers security and data policies and ensure adherence
Liason with cross functional teams to investigate customer issues and drive early resolution.
Prepare, validate and Share the data which are required to cleanup/correct/reconcile as a part of fix
Experience
3-5 years of related experience in Technical Analyst or equivalent role or 2-3 years in computer engineering or equivalent role
Some experience with a broad range of IT technologies: Network, Storage, Virtualization, Compute, Database, Automation, SDLC, and distributed transactions in high volume managed services or billing services provider environments
Additional Job Description
Under limited supervision, performs installations, configurations, and upgrades to CSG products.
Hands on experience in either 2 of the languages Python, C# and Shell/Powershell . Expertise in
one of this is mandatory
OS experience Windows and Linux
Experience in using monitoring tools
Basic understanding and working knowledge of CI/CD tools like Chef, Jenkins etc
Ability to troubleshoot issues and provide solution
Validation of installation and configuration processes and procedures.
Active participation/internship with the other teams involved in delivery (Development & Project Management).
Troubleshooting and bug fixing for solutions once in place.
Participate in the on-call rotation under the supervision of a senior team member
Releases & Promotions:
Under limited supervision, support the development team in releases and promotions (including core upgrades) from development through to production, as defined by Best Practices.
Validation of release and promotion processes and procedures.
Troubleshooting and bug fixing for solutions once in place.
Backups & Recovery:
With limited supervision, establishes and maintains system and database backup and recovery policies and procedures.
Solution & New Product Evaluation:
Assists in the identification and analysis of the internal/external clients technical requirements.
Under limited supervision, gathers information from customers on technical requirements.
Under limited supervision, provides technical input and consultation for application deployment.
Third Party & Open Source:
Under limited supervision, performs installation, configuration, and upgrades to any supporting
third-party software used in supporting CSG products.
Active research and sandbox trials of open source solutions.
Execute third party/open source compilation for requisite software.
Pull source and monitor version modifications in association with key software.
Familiarization of key third party products /open source projects leveraged by CSG solutions.
Communication & Documentation:
Effectively communicates with customers and colleagues alike.
Produces and maintains documentation on projects and research as assigned.
Creates wiki documentation for solution delivery and support, as well as, automation efforts.
Responsibility

% of Time
Administration of infrastructure systems (upgrade, maintain, troubleshoot) such as BigIP, CVP framework, BladeLogic, Automation, ADDM, CSP/IPF 20%
Serves as subject matter expert for matters relating to system and application architecture 20%
3rd tier support for operational production issues 40%
Participates in process improvement efforts within the larger technology organization 20%
Regular and reliable attendance is required.
Ongoing
Incumbent is accountable for professional working behavior to include; building and maintaining constructive working relationships, implementing proactive and concise communication, acting as a resource to colleagues, and engaging in collaborative thinking and problem solving while demonstrating CSGs core competencies and values.
Typical Interactions/Relationships
Internal Some contact with developers, dbas, operations, Systems Administrators, Global Platform Architecture.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Familiarity with practical agile development methodologies.
Familiarity with required coding (C #) and scripting languages (Shell Scripting).
General knowledge of database architecture and function.
Demonstrates a great deal of self-drive and initiative in a highly independent environment.
Knowledge of programming and systems analysis procedures.
Strong oral and written/editing skills.
Good interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of Linux Shell and Windows PowerShell scripting.
Works with some independence, yet most feature level work assigned by lead. Knows when to
seek guidance from teammates or lead.
Balances task load to deliver in a timely manner.
Involved in story creation and iterative planning.
Demonstrates solid skill and is working to gain additional experience
3-5 years of experience in application deployment and support.
Good Understanding of OS, Network, Database and application monitoring tools.
Demonstrates creativity when researching or solving a situation.
Knowledge of systems security and PCI compliance.
Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience.
Should have worked on Agile projects and should understand
C#
PowerShell/ Shell Scripting
Database Knowledge
Python or pearl will be added advantage
